_: THE ROLE WORDS of every behaviour recipe (docs/SVG_BEHAVIOUR_PLAN.md §3b). One table, three readers: the recipes take their roles from it, the mapping step's proposal matches layer names against `words` through the shared tokenizer, and scripts/behaviour-docs.mjs generates the designer-facing tables in docs/SVG_AUTHORING.md §5b from it - so a word taught in the docs is the word the matcher reads. JSON rather than TS because that script runs in plain Node. `words` is a case-insensitive regex source matched against the layer's name with its row key already taken out; `teach` is the one example name the docs print; `also` are the synonyms the docs list (every one must match `words` - the docs script checks). `pool` says which inventory a layer role is picked from: `text` (a text layer) or `drawn` (a group or a rectangle).
